toolsPreview.name: check_model
toolsPreview.description: Check whether an AI model identifier is deprecated, retiring, or has silently changed (price, context window, capabilities). Accepts any spelling a provider or SDK uses, e.g. 'gpt-4-turbo', 'azure/gpt-4.1-mini', 'claude-opus-4-1-20250805'. Call this before writing a model identifier into code.

toolsPreview.name: check_models
toolsPreview.description: Check many model identifiers at once and report which are retired or scheduled for retirement. Use when auditing a codebase or config.

toolsPreview.name: upcoming_retirements
toolsPreview.description: List models with an announced retirement date inside a horizon, soonest first.

toolsPreview.name: recent_changes
toolsPreview.description: Recent breaking changes across AI model APIs: price moves, context-window cuts, removed capabilities, removals. One entry per real upstream change.
